fauxConcrete.title: Faux Concrete Walls in Vancouver
body: A faux concrete wall uses a hand-applied decorative coating to recreate the movement, tonal variation and architectural character of concrete on an existing interior wall.

Depending on the substrate and the look you want, the finish may use microcement or a layered decorative plaster system. We review the wall condition, colour, texture and sheen before recommending a build-up and preparing a project-specific sample.
highlights: Living rooms, bedrooms, offices and commercial feature walls
Smooth, clouded or more visibly hand-textured effects
Cool grey, warm neutral and custom colour directions
Sample approval before the full decorative finish is applied
fauxConcrete.note: A faux concrete finish is decorative and is not the same as poured, structural or polished concrete. The existing wall and selected finish system determine the preparation and protective coating required.

cost.title: What Does an Accent Wall Cost in Vancouver?
cost.intro: For early planning, published Vancouver examples place many single-wall projects between a few hundred and a few thousand dollars. The finish, wall size and preparation required make a major difference, so these market ranges are not a VV Renovation price list.

ranges.text: A straightforward colour change is usually the lowest-cost option. Repairs, primer, dark colour changes and difficult access can add labour.
Trim layout, material, cutting around outlets and the final painted or stained finish determine the scope.
Layered texture, stencil work, metallic effects and detailed surface preparation increase time and material use.
Premium decorative systems are quoted after the substrate, dimensions, sample finish and required protective coating are reviewed.

factors: Existing cracks, texture or drywall repairs
Finish system, colour layers and sample approval
Corners, niches, fireplaces, outlets and built-ins
Furniture protection, access and occupied-space setup
cost.note: Planning ranges are based on currently published Vancouver market examples and are not fixed VV Renovation prices. Your written estimate is based on the actual wall, finish and site conditions.

items.question: What types of accent walls do you install?
items.answer: We install microcement walls, marble decorative finishes, stucco textures, and fully custom feature walls tailored to your interior design.

items.question: Are accent walls suitable for any room?
items.answer: Yes, accent walls can be installed in living rooms, bedrooms, offices, commercial spaces, and feature areas where you want to create visual impact.

items.question: How long does accent wall installation take?
items.answer: Most accent wall projects take from 1 to 5 days depending on the material, wall size, and complexity of the design.

items.question: How much does an accent wall cost in Vancouver?
items.answer: Published Vancouver planning examples commonly range from about $250–$1,000 for a painted feature wall, $900–$2,500 for a panelled wall, and $600–$3,000 or more for hand-finished plaster. Microcement, marble effects and highly custom textures require a project-specific estimate. These are market references, not fixed VV Renovation prices.

items.question: What is a faux concrete wall finish?
items.answer: A faux concrete wall is a decorative, hand-applied finish that recreates the tonal variation and architectural look of concrete on an existing wall. Depending on the substrate and desired texture, the finish may use microcement or a layered plaster system. It is decorative rather than poured or structural concrete.

items.question: Do you help with design and material selection?
items.answer: Yes, we help you choose the right finish, color, and texture based on your space, lighting, and overall interior style.

items.question: Are decorative finishes durable?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use high-quality materials and proper surface preparation to ensure long-lasting, durable and easy-to-maintain finishes.

items.question: Do you work across the Greater Vancouver Area?
items.answer: Yes, we provide accent wall installation services across Vancouver and surrounding areas including Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, New Westminster, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, White Rock, North Vancouver (City), North Vancouver (District), West Vancouver, Delta, Langley (City), Langley (Township).
